newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER SHOWCASE-PORTO BEAT BENFICA 2-1 IN LISBON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-PORTO BEAT BENFICA 2-1 IN LISBON.

text.p: Porto beat main rivals Benfica 2-1 on Saturday in a match that never really came alive to extend their lead at the top of the Portuguese league to a commanding eight points.

Brazilian striker Mario Jardel put the visitors ahead in the 23rd minute with a typically clinical strike, controlling a cross on his chest before volleying past a helpless Michel Preud'Homme in the Benfica goal.
Benfica captain Joaa Vieira Pinto briefly raised the hopes of his team's massed fans in the 75,000 crowd when he nipped in to head home at the start of the second half.
The goal marked a period of sustained pressure from the Lisbon club, which had lacked the courage to press forward earlier even after falling a goal behind.

But a few minutes later a fierce drive from a free kick by Porto midfielder Jose Barroso, which Preud'Homme failed to gather, was put into the net by defender Jorge Costa to give the reigning champions a deserved victory.
The win leaves Porto, going for a record third successive league title, with 41 points. Benfica are second on 33 and Sporting third on 30.
